Portronics Harmony II Party Speaker – Powerful 60W Bluetooth Sound

Turn any gathering into a celebration with the Portronics Harmony II Party Speaker. Designed for music lovers who want deep bass, clear vocals, and reliable wireless performance, this speaker delivers an impressive 60W output that easily fills rooms, terraces, or outdoor spaces. Whether you’re hosting a house party, enjoying a weekend get-together, or setting the mood for travel, Harmony II brings immersive audio with punchy lows and vibrant highs.

Equipped with the latest Bluetooth 5.3 technology, the speaker ensures faster pairing, stable connectivity, and low power consumption. Stream your favorite playlists from smartphones, tablets, or laptops without interruptions. With a robust 5000mAh battery, you can enjoy up to 5 hours of playtime at maximum volume, making it perfect for extended music sessions.

The premium finish and stylish design in Gold and Grey complement modern interiors while being rugged enough for portable use. Multiple input options including USB and AUX allow flexible playback, so your music never stops even without Bluetooth. From Bollywood hits to EDM nights, Harmony II adapts to every vibe with rich, room-filling sound.

If you are searching for a powerful wireless party speaker, portable Bluetooth speaker with bass, or a rechargeable speaker for home entertainment, the Harmony II is built to deliver performance and reliability. Easy controls, strong build quality, and loud output make it a dependable choice for birthdays, celebrations, and casual listening alike.

Key Features

  • Model: Harmony II
  • Audio Output: 60W high-power stereo sound
  • Bluetooth Version: v5.3 for stable and fast connectivity
  • Battery Capacity: 5000mAh rechargeable battery
  • Playtime: Up to 5 hours at max volume
  • Ports: USB and AUX input support
  • Color Options: Gold, Grey
  • Usage: Ideal for house parties, indoor & outdoor events

Why Choose?

The combines portability with performance. Its powerful drivers are tuned for dynamic bass and crisp treble, giving you a live-concert feel. Bluetooth 5.3 ensures lag-free streaming, while versatile ports keep you connected to multiple devices. The long-lasting battery supports uninterrupted entertainment, and the bold design makes it stand out wherever you place it.

Perfect for users looking for loud Bluetooth, party with USB playback, or portable music systems with rechargeable batteries, Harmony II offers outstanding value. Enjoy dependable sound, stylish looks, and easy usability packed into one impressive device.
